resources.string: Splitz uses this Accessibility Service exclusively to automate placing your selected app pairs into split screen. The service is required for automatic split-screen placement; without it, apps will only open sequentially. Splitz operates 100% offline, without internet access, and does not read, collect, or transmit screen contents, keystrokes, or personal data.
Launch paired apps in split screen with Accessibility Service automation.

Splitz lets you pair any two installed apps and launch them together in split screen with a single tap from your home screen or within the app.
Accessibility Service Disclosure: Splitz uses Android\'s Accessibility Service API exclusively to automate placing the two selected apps into Android\'s native split-screen mode.
Important: • The Accessibility Service must be enabled for automatic split-screen placement. • Without the Accessibility Service enabled, Splitz will open the two apps sequentially one after another, but cannot automatically place them into split screen. • Privacy & Security: Splitz operates 100% offline with zero network connectivity (no INTERNET permission requested or used). The Accessibility Service does not read screen contents, monitor keystrokes, track personal data, or transmit any information.
